A UAS flies a lawnmower pattern over a wireframe terrain. The red dot is the camera, the green square is its footprint on the ground, and the lines from the camera to the red points are the rays to features it can see; the trail of white squares is the coverage so far. Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom. [Open the demo full screen](sfm_demo_embed.html).
